original.target_description: Experiment 1a: planned contrast of footbridge switch versus footbridge pole, isolating personal force on moral acceptability; F(1, 417) = 7.63, p = 0.006, d = 0.40.

n.exclusions: 31 of 664 excluded for inability/unwillingness to suspend disbelief and 10 for confusion. Target-group allocation of exclusions and critical-model missingness are not established.

notes: Identity verified from supplied canonical text: matching title Pushing moral buttons: The interaction between personal force and intention in moral judgment; all six named authors; doi:10.1016/j.cognition.2009.02.001. Primary article-in-press manuscript in Cognition, with methods, results and references across eight pages; no source PDF supplied. Pagination is manuscript pagination. Only n_o assigned; all other fields are unassigned placeholders. Target matched using study identifier and substantive manipulation/test, not row order or numerical matching. The design supplies mutually exclusive condition counts, but does not explicitly identify them as final critical-model groups. Further, four condition counts sum to 468 while the subject demographics sum to 620, and the exclusion paragraph refers to 664. Do not promote 232 or 620/623/468 to analytic N. No derivation from model degrees of freedom. Candidate arithmetic only: pole 72 + switch 160 = 232; all four design groups 154 + 82 + 72 + 160 = 468; demographics 271 + 337 + 12 = 620; exclusion accounting 664 - 31 - 10 = 623. None established as target analytic N. Printed test statistics above identify the target only; no effect-size conversion performed.
